doc: HUD part: the sword-move wheel that opens around the strike button while the finger is down on it. Five sectors and the centre, glyphs only; the chosen move is named once above the wheel. `moves` = [{id, icon, sector: '<index>'|'centre', disabled}], `selected` = the sector of the chosen move. The sector edges are the same angles the strike button's swipe uses (hud-layout.json, data swipe-bounds).
